note: The four EE files this repository rebuilds byte for byte.  They come from
your own copy of the game and are never distributed here: point XENO_GAME_DIR
at the folder holding them (default: game/extracted-iso).
This is the NTSC-U release; a different release has different hashes and this
Disc 2 boots SLUS_214.17, byte-identical to SLUS_213.89; OV01.OVL, OV02.OVL, OV04.OVL
and the IOP/ directory are identical on both discs, so one extracted disc is enough.
